name: haikei
description: Build and operate AI assistants with the Kei platform: set up and manage organizations, workspaces, data connectors, groups, policies, and users against the ABAC API, log in and manage runtime installations with the kei CLI, stand up and bootstrap customer-hosted runtimes, rotate runtime credentials, connect Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, and Cursor to Kei, enforce policy and audit on agent tool calls with the agentware SDK, diagnose Kei runtime installations with the setup doctor, and develop the DVL Assistant's ingress security, Teams integration, tool adapters, headless evals, and OpenAI-compatible backend wiring, and resource-oriented API endpoint conventions (AIP-style routes, custom methods, migrations).
